These are my shadows created from the parts of\nmy body...\nHow dare you destroy them, you fools...
I will end you with my own hands.\nCome to the Gate of Another World!
Wai-wai-Wait! \nDidn't you hear that?!
He's obviously going out of his mind because of\nthe evil energy...
Moreover, he can create such monsters using his\nparts of body, so he's no longer a human, right?!
And, he was sealing the gate at the expense of\nhis body, wasn't he?
If he had become a monster, then the seal of the\ngate must have been broken and much more horrible\nmonsters might be coming, right?!
...No. We've gotta run!!
You said you were prepared.
What are you saying?!\nThe situation has changed!!
You can't beat all the monsters alone!\nI don't wanna get involved in it!\nI don't wanna die!
Then, where are you going?
As you said, Majua turned into an evil existence\nand the gate might have opened...
As a result, the monsters might be coming into\nthis world through the Gate of Another World...
If that's true, sooner or later there will be\nno place to hide...There is no option but to\ndefeat Majua and [the things] from the gate...
Hmm... I can't go back alone, so...\nI have to go with you...
Daahh! Fine!\nI'll follow you to the end of the\nworld!!
